ledger_name: ArcheAxis OS / Cognitive-Loop-OS supply chain ledger
note: MFX-001. Each component records licence gate + exact-revision tracking. code_license and model_license are kept separate. 'approved' means past licence review for default use; 'review_required'/'blocked' means capability probes must report the component as unavailable until licence decision. This ledger does not itself grant redistribution rights; it records the project's decision state.
